question: Where can I find the Yukon government’s list of treaties and self-government agreements with Indigenous governments?
generated_answer:
You can find this information on the Government of Yukon’s website, specifically on the page related to Indigenous Affairs and Reconciliation. There, you’ll find a list of treaties and self-government agreements that have been signed with different Indigenous governments in the Yukon. Additionally, you may also find this information on the website of the Council of Yukon First Nations (CYFN) or other Indigenous organizations in the territory.

Here are some specific resources to get you started:

1. Government of Yukon – Indigenous Affairs and Reconciliation:
   - [Government of Yukon – Indigenous Affairs and Reconciliation](https://www.gov.yk.ca/health/indigenous/index.html)

2. Council of Yukon First Nations (CYFN):
   - [Council of Yukon First Nations (CYFN)](https://www.cyfn.ca/)

3. Yukon Land Claims and Self-Government:
   - [Yukon Land Claims and Self-Government](https://www.gov.yk.ca/health/indigenous/landclaims.html)

Remember to look for sections or links related to treaties, self-government agreements, or Indigenous governments within these resources. If you have specific questions about a particular treaty or agreement, you might also want to reach out to the relevant Indigenous government or the Government of Yukon for more detailed information. 

It’s also important to note that while the Government of Yukon and Indigenous governments may provide information on treaties and self-government agreements, the interpretation of these agreements and the rights and responsibilities they entail can sometimes be complex and may require legal or specialized expertise to fully understand. 

For the most up-to-date and detailed information, it is always best to consult the primary sources mentioned above or reach out to the relevant organizations directly. 

If you are looking for a specific treaty or self-government agreement, you might want to use search terms such as "Yukon Treaty" or "Yukon Self-Government Agreement" along with the name of the Indigenous government or the year of the agreement, if known.
